audit_status.source_base: Hebrew 2 Kings / Melakhim Bet Jehu anointing, coup, royal killings, and Jezebel death narrative, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for secret anointing, coup dynamics, watchtower reports, Joram and Ahaziah killings, Naboth-land oracle, Jezebel's presentation and taunt, eunuch participation, trampling, body desecration, and prophetic fulfillment rhetoric.

verses.restored: Elisha the prophet called one of sons of prophets and said to him, Gird your loins, take this flask of oil in your hand, and go to Ramoth-gilead.

familiar.text: And Elisha the prophet called one of the children of the prophets, and said unto him, Gird up thy loins, and take this box of oil in thine hand, and go to Ramothgilead:

verses.restored: When you come there, look for Jehu son of Jehoshaphat son of Nimshi. Go in, make him rise from among his brothers, and bring him into an inner room.

familiar.text: And when thou comest thither, look out there Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, and go in, and make him arise up from among his brethren, and carry him to an inner chamber;

verses.restored: Take flask of oil, pour it on his head, and say, Thus says YHWH: I have anointed you king over Israel. Then open door, flee, and do not wait.

familiar.text: Then take the box of oil, and pour it on his head, and say, Thus saith the LORD, I have anointed thee king over Israel. Then open the door, and flee, and tarry not.

verses.restored: The young man, servant of prophet, went to Ramoth-gilead.

familiar.text: So the young man, even the young man the prophet, went to Ramothgilead.

verses.restored: He came, and look, commanders of army were sitting. He said, A word I have for you, commander. Jehu said, For which of all of us? He said, For you, commander.

familiar.text: And when he came, behold, the captains of the host were sitting; and he said, I have an errand to thee, O captain. And Jehu said, Unto which of all us? And he said, To thee, O captain.

verses.restored: He rose and went into house. He poured oil on his head and said to him, Thus says YHWH Divine of Israel: I have anointed you king over people of YHWH, over Israel.

familiar.text: And he arose, and went into the house; and he poured the oil on his head, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I have anointed thee king over the people of the LORD, even over Israel.

verses.restored: You shall strike house of Ahab your master, so I may avenge blood of my servants the prophets and blood of all servants of YHWH from hand of Jezebel.

familiar.text: And thou shalt smite the house of Ahab thy master, that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of the LORD, at the hand of Jezebel.

verses.restored: All house of Ahab shall perish; I will cut off from Ahab every male, restrained and released in Israel.

familiar.text: For the whole house of Ahab shall perish: and I will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel:

verses.restored: I will make house of Ahab like house of Jeroboam son of Nebat and like house of Baasha son of Ahijah.

familiar.text: And I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah:

verses.restored: Dogs shall eat Jezebel in portion of Jezreel, and none shall bury her. Then he opened door and fled.

familiar.text: And the dogs shall eat Jezebel in the portion of Jezreel, and there shall be none to bury her. And he opened the door, and fled.

verses.restored: Jehu went out to servants of his lord. One said to him, Is there peace? Why did this madman come to you? He said to them, You know the man and his talk.

familiar.text: Then Jehu came forth to the servants of his lord: and one said unto him, Is all well? wherefore came this mad fellow to thee? And he said unto them, Ye know the man, and his communication.

verses.restored: They said, False! Tell us, please. He said, Thus and thus he spoke to me, saying, Thus says YHWH: I have anointed you king over Israel.

familiar.text: And they said, It is false; tell us now. And he said, Thus and thus spake he to me, saying, Thus saith the LORD, I have anointed thee king over Israel.

verses.restored: They hurried, each took his garment and put it under him on bare steps, blew trumpet, and said, Jehu is king!

familiar.text: Then they hasted, and took every man his garment, and put it under him on the top of the stairs, and blew with trumpets, saying, Jehu is king.

verses.restored: Jehu son of Jehoshaphat son of Nimshi conspired against Joram. Joram had been guarding Ramoth-gilead, he and all Israel, because of Hazael king of Aram.

familiar.text: So Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi conspired against Joram. (Now Joram had kept Ramothgilead, he and all Israel, because of Hazael king of Syria.

verses.restored: King Joram returned to Jezreel to heal from wounds Arameans struck him when he fought Hazael king of Aram. Jehu said, If your soul is with me, let no fugitive go out from city to tell in Jezreel.

familiar.text: But king Joram was returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria.) And Jehu said, If it be your minds, then let none go forth nor escape out of the city to go to tell it in Jezreel.

verses.restored: Jehu rode and went to Jezreel, for Joram was lying there, and Ahaziah king of Judah had gone down to see Joram.

familiar.text: So Jehu rode in a chariot, and went to Jezreel; for Joram lay there. And Ahaziah king of Judah was come down to see Joram.

verses.restored: The watchman stood on tower in Jezreel and saw company of Jehu coming. He said, I see a company. Joram said, Take a rider and send to meet them, and let him say, Is there peace?

familiar.text: And there stood a watchman on the tower in Jezreel, and he spied the company of Jehu as he came, and said, I see a company. And Joram said, Take an horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say, Is it peace?

verses.restored: The horseman went to meet him and said, Thus says king: Is there peace? Jehu said, What is there to you and peace? Turn behind me. Watchman reported, Messenger reached them and does not return.

familiar.text: So there went one on horseback to meet him, and said, Thus saith the king, Is it peace? And Jehu said, What hast thou to do with peace? turn thee behind me. And the watchman told, saying, The messenger came to them, but he cometh not again.

verses.restored: He sent a second horseman. He came to them and said, Thus says king: Is there peace? Jehu said, What is there to you and peace? Turn behind me.

familiar.text: Then he sent out a second on horseback, which came to them, and said, Thus saith the king, Is it peace? And Jehu answered, What hast thou to do with peace? turn thee behind me.

verses.restored: Watchman reported, He reached them and does not return; driving is like driving of Jehu son of Nimshi, for he drives with madness/fury.

familiar.text: And the watchman told, saying, He came even unto them, and cometh not again: and the driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi; for he driveth furiously.

verses.restored: Joram said, Harness. They harnessed his chariot. Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out, each in his chariot, to meet Jehu; they found him at portion of Naboth the Jezreelite.

familiar.text: And Joram said, Make ready. And his chariot was made ready. And Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out, each in his chariot, and they went out against Jehu, and met him in the portion of Naboth the Jezreelite.

verses.restored: When Joram saw Jehu, he said, Is there peace, Jehu? He said, What peace, while prostitutions/idolatries of Jezebel your mother and her many sorceries remain?

familiar.text: And it came to pass, when Joram saw Jehu, that he said, Is it peace, Jehu? And he answered, What peace, so long as the whoredoms of thy mother Jezebel and her witchcrafts are so many?

verses.restored: Joram turned his hands and fled and said to Ahaziah, Treachery, Ahaziah!

familiar.text: And Joram turned his hands, and fled, and said to Ahaziah, There is treachery, O Ahaziah.

verses.restored: Jehu drew bow with full strength and struck Joram between his arms; arrow went out through his heart, and he sank in his chariot.

familiar.text: And Jehu drew a bow with his full strength, and smote Jehoram between his arms, and the arrow went out at his heart, and he sunk down in his chariot.

verses.restored: Jehu said to Bidkar his officer, Lift and throw him into portion of field of Naboth the Jezreelite, for remember, when I and you rode together after Ahab his father, YHWH lifted this burden against him.

familiar.text: Then said Jehu to Bidkar his captain, Take up, and cast him in the portion of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite: for remember how that, when I and thou rode together after Ahab his father, the LORD laid this burden upon him;

verses.restored: Surely I saw yesterday blood of Naboth and blood of his sons, says YHWH, and I will repay you in this portion, says YHWH. Now lift and throw him into portion, according to word of YHWH.

familiar.text: Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth, and the blood of his sons, saith the LORD; and I will requite thee in this plat, saith the LORD. Now therefore take and cast him into the plat of ground, according to the word of the LORD.

verses.restored: Ahaziah king of Judah saw and fled by way of garden house. Jehu pursued him and said, Strike him also in chariot. They struck him at ascent of Gur by Ibleam. He fled to Megiddo and died there.

familiar.text: But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this, he fled by the way of the garden house. And Jehu followed after him, and said, Smite him also in the chariot. And they did so at the going up to Gur, which is by Ibleam. And he fled to Megiddo, and died there.

verses.restored: His servants carried him in chariot to Jerusalem and buried him in his tomb with his fathers in city of David.

familiar.text: And his servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his sepulchre with his fathers in the city of David.

verses.restored: In eleventh year of Joram son of Ahab, Ahaziah had become king over Judah.

familiar.text: And in the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab began Ahaziah to reign over Judah.

verses.restored: Jehu came to Jezreel. Jezebel heard; she put paint on her eyes, arranged her head, and looked out through window.

familiar.text: And when Jehu was come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her face, and tired her head, and looked out at a window.

verses.restored: As Jehu entered gate, she said, Is there peace, Zimri, killer of his master?

familiar.text: And as Jehu entered in at the gate, she said, Had Zimri peace, who slew his master?

verses.restored: He lifted his face toward window and said, Who is with me? Who? Two or three eunuchs looked down to him.

familiar.text: And he lifted up his face to the window, and said, Who is on my side? who? And there looked out to him two or three eunuchs.

verses.restored: He said, Throw her down. They threw her down, and some of her blood splattered on wall and horses, and he trampled her.

familiar.text: And he said, Throw her down. So they threw her down: and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses: and he trode her under foot.

verses.restored: He came in, ate and drank, and said, Attend now to this cursed woman and bury her, for she is daughter of a king.

familiar.text: And when he was come in, he did eat and drink, and said, Go, see now this cursed woman, and bury her: for she is a king’s daughter.

verses.restored: They went to bury her, but found no more of her than skull, feet, and palms of hands.

familiar.text: And they went to bury her: but they found no more of her than the skull, and the feet, and the palms of her hands.

verses.restored: They returned and told him. He said, This is word of YHWH that he spoke by hand of Elijah the Tishbite, saying, In portion of Jezreel dogs shall eat flesh of Jezebel.

familiar.text: Wherefore they came again, and told him. And he said, This is the word of the LORD, which he spake by his servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, In the portion of Jezreel shall dogs eat the flesh of Jezebel:

verses.restored: Corpse of Jezebel shall be as dung on face of field in portion of Jezreel, so they will not say, This is Jezebel.

familiar.text: And the carcase of Jezebel shall be as dung upon the face of the field in the portion of Jezreel; so that they shall not say, This is Jezebel.

translation_notes: Jehu's anointing is secret, hurried, and immediately becomes a military coup. Prophetic commissioning does not remove accountability for methods, targets, or civilian consequences.
The command to destroy Ahab's entire house repeats dynastic-extermination rhetoric and must never justify family killing, inherited guilt, or political purges.
Calling the prophetic messenger a 'madman' reflects contempt toward ecstatic or unusual behavior; it must not be weaponized against mentally ill or neurodivergent people.
Joram is killed while recovering from battle wounds, and Ahaziah is pursued and killed while visiting him. Coup success is not due process.
Naboth's murdered family is invoked as the moral grievance behind Joram's death, but restorative justice cannot be achieved through another unlawful killing.
Jezebel's cosmetics and arranged hair may signal royal dignity, defiance, seduction, or death preparation. They must not support misogynistic readings that blame appearance, sexuality, or femininity.
Jezebel is thrown from a window, trampled, eaten by dogs, and denied burial. This is body desecration and gendered humiliation, not a spiritually satisfying ending.
The eunuchs' role may reflect palace coercion, survival, or alliance with Jehu; the text does not grant access to their motives.
Prophetic-fulfillment language reports the narrator's theology but does not make corpse abuse, misogyny, or coup violence ethically normative.
safety_note: Do not use 2 Kings 9 to justify coups, summary execution, family extermination, misogyny toward Jezebel, mental-health slurs, corpse desecration, or the claim that prophetic authorization removes legal and moral accountability. Keep Naboth's injustice visible without turning vengeance into justice.
